artworks.title: Saint George and the Dragon
artworks.medium: brush and brown and white gouache
artworks.creditLine: Julius S. Held Collection, Ailsa Mellon Bruce Fund
artworks.description: This is a painting featuring a knight battling a dragon. The artwork depicts a knight on horseback, wielding a lance towards a dragon below. The dragon's body is detailed with scales and wings, giving a sense of movement and tension. Cherubic figures float among clouds above, and a draped figure reaches skyward to the left. The painting is full of energy and drama, with swift lines and swirling forms. It is in the style of Peter Paul Rubens, capturing a moment of action and storytelling.

artworks.title: Dr. Ernst Wagner
artworks.medium: black crayon on wove paper
artworks.creditLine: Julius S. Held Collection, Ailsa Mellon Bruce Fund
artworks.description: The image is a drawing of a person from the waist up. The person is seated with their arms resting in front of them, one hand over the other. The figure has defined facial features with hollow cheeks and deep-set eyes. Their hair appears combed back with a receding hairline. The clothing depicted is a jacket or coat with a bow tie around the neck. There are no visible jewelry or objects held by the person. The background is plain, consisting of blank paper, emphasizing the sketched person without distraction.

artworks.title: The Virgin and Child with John the Baptist
artworks.medium: black chalk on laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Julius S. Held Collection, Ailsa Mellon Bruce Fund
artworks.description: The image shows a drawing with three main figures and several background figures. The central figure is seated and holding a child on their lap. The adult figure has a softly drawn face, shoulder-length hair, and flowing clothing with shadows and folds. A small child is seated close by, and another child is standing to the left holding a staff. In the background are lightly sketched figures and indistinct shapes, possibly cherubs. The drawing has a textured appearance.

artworks.title: River God with Putti
artworks.medium: pen and gray and black ink with brush and gray wash on laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Julius S. Held Collection, Ailsa Mellon Bruce Fund
artworks.description: This is a drawing of mythological figures among foliage and decorative elements. The composition features cherubic figures, ornate decorative elements, a horn of plenty overflowing with fruit and flowers on the left, a reclining figure at the bottom right, and a cherubic figure with wings and a bird on the right. The style is classical with fluid lines and intricate details typical of mythological or allegorical themes in art, implying movement and playfulness.

artworks.title: Annunciation to the Shepherds
artworks.medium: pen and brown ink with brown wash, heightened  with white
artworks.creditLine: Julius S. Held Collection, Ailsa Mellon Bruce Fund
artworks.description: This is a drawing of an angelic figure appearing to shepherds. The angel descends from the clouds above, holding a scroll and surrounded by heavenly beings. Below the angel, a group of shepherds react to the divine apparition. One of the shepherds is pointing upwards toward the heavenly figure. The background includes a pastoral setting with sheep scattered around and an outline of buildings in the distance.

artworks.title: The Assumption of the Virgin
artworks.medium: pen and brown ink with golden brown wash over graphite
artworks.creditLine: Julius S. Held Collection, Ailsa Mellon Bruce Fund
artworks.description: The image depicts a celestial scene with supernatural beings. It shows winged figures within swirling clouds, with bursts of light. Some figures hold instruments or symbols. The composition leads the eye upward, giving a sense of spiritual elevation or divine gathering. The use of sepia tones and delicate lines adds an ethereal quality to the scene, suggesting an old-world subject. The figures appear to be in motion, creating a dynamic and uplifting atmosphere.

artworks.title: Birth of Venus
artworks.medium: pen and brown ink with gray wash on laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Julius S. Held Collection, Ailsa Mellon Bruce Fund
artworks.description: The image consists of swirling lines and curved shapes that create an abstract scene with human-like figures. Some figures are seated while others appear to be in motion against a cloud-like backdrop. The composition conveys a sense of a celestial gathering, with the figures floating in the airy environment.

artworks.title: Tritons and Nymphs
artworks.medium: pen and brown ink with brown wash over black chalk
artworks.creditLine: Julius S. Held Collection, Ailsa Mellon Bruce Fund
artworks.description: This image shows a mythological scene with figures intertwined with serpentine forms. The drawing features several nude figures with limbs intertwining with serpent-like tails, appearing to be engaged in an embrace or dance. The use of lines and shading on rough, beige-toned paper enhances the dimensionality and texture of the figures. Swirling lines in the composition add movement and complexity, evoking drama and energy. The piece is rendered in a classical style with intricate details, focusing on human anatomy and mythological themes.

artworks.title: God the Father Seated in Clouds Surrounded by Angels and Putti
artworks.medium: pen and gray ink with golden brown wash over black chalk on laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Julius S. Held Collection, Ailsa Mellon Bruce Fund
artworks.description: The image shows flowing lines and curved shapes, creating an abstract scene that suggests movement and energy. The drawing includes figures with wings and flowing robes, evoking images of angels or mythical creatures in flight. Two winged figures appear to be pointing or gesturing forward, while a smaller figure with wings resembles a cherub or putto. The design features swirling lines and overlapping shapes, resembling the dynamic and ethereal quality of clouds or waves, giving the scene a sense of airy fluidity.

artworks.title: A Venetian Lawyer at His Desk
artworks.medium: pen and black ink with gray wash on laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Julius S. Held Collection, Ailsa Mellon Bruce Fund
artworks.description: The image shows a person sitting on a chair in profile view, writing on a table with a quill. The individual has exaggerated facial features, long hair, and is dressed in loose-fitting clothing. They are seated on a wooden chair with an inkpot on the table in front of them. The background is plain.

artworks.title: Head of a Matron
artworks.medium: black and red chalk on laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Julius S. Held Collection, Ailsa Mellon Bruce Fund
artworks.description: The drawing shows a close-up of a female's face with large eyes, a straight nose, slightly pursed lips, and a hint of blush on the cheeks. Her hair is covered by a cloth or headscarf that wraps around her head and drapes down with ruffled edges framing her face. She is not wearing visible jewelry. The background is plain with a textured shading that contrasts with the detailed rendering of her face and head covering.

artworks.title: Psyche Giving Her Coin to Charon
artworks.medium: pen and brown ink with gray wash over black chalk on laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Julius S. Held Collection, Ailsa Mellon Bruce Fund
artworks.description: The image depicts two full figures in a sketch style. The male figure stands in a wooden boat with one foot inside and the other on a rocky surface. He is muscular and draped in a piece of fabric, with long, dark hair and a beard. The female figure stands on the ground in a sheer dress, with long hair adorned with a headpiece. She faces the male figure. The background shows a rough rocky terrain with minimal detail.

artworks.title: Saint John the Evangelist
artworks.medium: pen and brown ink with brown wash, heightened with white, on blue paper
artworks.creditLine: Julius S. Held Collection, Ailsa Mellon Bruce Fund
artworks.description: The image depicts a person shown from the upper legs up, seated in a relaxed posture with one leg raised slightly. The individual is looking upwards and has distinctive facial features with long wavy hair falling past the shoulders. Their apparel consists of flowing robes with broad, sweeping sleeves. The person is holding a long quill in one hand. A large bird is perched beside them, with its wings partially extended. The background is a simple, unadorned blue-gray gradient with a handwritten inscription at the top of the image that reads "S. Ioun: Ev:".

artworks.title: Three Revelers and a Gardner
artworks.medium: pen and brown ink with brown wash over black chalkon laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Julius S. Held Collection, Ailsa Mellon Bruce Fund
artworks.description: The image shows three figures in full body length sketches. The figure on the left is dressed in a broad-brimmed hat and knee-breeches, raising an arm high. The central figure, a child with a cap, holds up a scroll. On the right, a figure wearing a wide hat and long coat stands with a shovel over one shoulder and a bundle of tools. The sketch is done in ink and wash on aged paper. The background is plain.

artworks.title: The Adoration of the Shepherds
artworks.medium: pen and brown ink with brown wash and blue gouache heightened with white on wove paper mounted to board
artworks.creditLine: Julius S. Held Collection, Avalon Fund
artworks.description: This is a painting of a nativity scene. The artwork shows an indoor setting with a baby lying in a manger surrounded by figures. One woman is kneeling in front of the baby with her hands together. Other figures are standing and observing, some with their hands raised or clasped. Animals can be seen in the background. The color palette features shades of sepia and earth tones, with subtle blue accents in the sky visible through the rustic roof's opening. The style is reminiscent of Benjamin West.

artworks.title: The Crucifixion
artworks.medium: pen and brown and black ink with blue, black, and red chalk on laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Julius S. Held Collection, Avalon Fund
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a crucifixion scene with figures surrounding. The image contains a central figure on a cross with several other figures gathered at the base of the cross. Winged figures are present, hovering above and around the central scene within a cloud-filled atmosphere. The drawing is detailed with lines in shades of blue and red. The surrounding figures appear to be engaged and attentive.

artworks.title: The Disobedient Prophet
artworks.medium: pen and black ink with wash heightened with blue and cream oil paint over chalk
artworks.creditLine: Julius S. Held Collection, Avalon Fund
artworks.description: The image shows two men and several animals in a dramatic scene. The first man is lying on the ground, propped up on one elbow, with a distressed expression. He has white hair and a beard, wearing a simple garment. The second man is leaning forward, one arm stretched out, with wild white hair and a beard, wearing a long-sleeved garment. A lion is near the prone man, facing him. In the background, there are two oxen, a visible one and a partially obscured one. A large tree with foliage is at the top, with a softly colored sky in the background. The scene is signed "B. West, 1793."

artworks.title: Vagabond Family [recto]
artworks.medium: pen and brown ink with brown and blue wash on wove paper
artworks.creditLine: Julius S. Held Collection, Avalon Fund
artworks.description: The image features three figures in an illustrative style. On the left side, two individuals embrace – a woman standing on the left and slightly bending down towards a child. The woman has delicately sketched facial features and hair styled with tight curls or buns. The child's face is partially obscured but seems to be looking up. Both are dressed in flowing robes or dresses. On the right, a man stands slightly angled towards the pair. He has prominent facial features, wears a hat with a brim, short hair, a tunic, an overgarment, and boots. His hands are clasped together in front of his chest. The background shows a loosely rendered sky with pale blue and beige tones, suggesting an outdoor setting. The figures have light outlines, creating a gentle, pastoral atmosphere.

artworks.title: Cross Section of a Gothic Church [verso]
artworks.medium: graphite and pen and brown ink
artworks.creditLine: Julius S. Held Collection, Avalon Fund
artworks.description: This is a drawing of an architectural design. The image shows a pencil and ink sketch of an archway with a measurement notation. The drawing is minimal, occupying a portion of the right side of the sheet, leaving the majority of the page blank.

artworks.title: The Judgment of Paris
artworks.medium: red chalk on laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Julius S. Held Collection, Ailsa Mellon Bruce Fund
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a scene set among the clouds. The composition features numerous figures in dynamic poses, interspersed with swirling clouds. Some figures are reclining or standing on the clouds, while others appear to be flying or in mid-motion. The drawing's layout suggests a celestial gathering or narrative, enveloped in a warm reddish tint. The border of the image is shaped in a decorative manner. The scene is rich with classical allusions.

artworks.title: Man in a Great Coat
artworks.artist: American 18th Century or Possibly Joseph Badger
artworks.medium: graphite with gouache on vellum
artworks.creditLine: John Davis Hatch Collection
artworks.description: The image depicts a man's upper body viewed from a three-quarter angle, from the chest up. He is portrayed in a slightly angled, forward-facing position with his head turned slightly to his left. His facial features include eyes, a nose, and lips. His hair is styled in a classical fashion, brushed back from the forehead. He is dressed in a dark coat with wide lapels and shiny buttons, a white high-collared shirt, and a cravat tied around his neck. The background is simple and textured with a muted tone that complements the drawing's sepia tones.

artworks.title: Koln, Maria-Capitol
artworks.medium: pen and black ink over graphite
artworks.creditLine: John Davis Hatch Collection
artworks.description: This is a drawing of an architectural interior of a vaulted corridor. The sketch shows a perspective view of a corridor with arches, columns, and high vaulted ceilings. Shadows cast by the architectural elements add contrast to the drawing. The intricate linework and detail create a three-dimensional effect. Light and shade emphasize the texture of the floor and ornate designs on the walls. The style is architectural, focusing on symmetry and perspective.

artworks.title: The Bronx
artworks.medium: charcoal
artworks.creditLine: John Davis Hatch Collection
artworks.description: The image depicts a scene in a park or natural area. The viewpoint is at eye level, capturing a tranquil setting. The horizon is high, with trees silhouetted against the sky. The drawing appears to be in charcoal with expressive brushstrokes. The color palette is monochromatic, with shades of grays and blacks creating contrasts between light and shadow. The composition includes a patch of lighter ground, possibly a path, leading to dense trees in the distance.

artworks.title: The Arno in the Evening, Florence
artworks.medium: pen and black ink with black wash
artworks.creditLine: John Davis Hatch Collection
artworks.description: The image shows a riverbank with a bridge and buildings in the background. The horizon is defined by rooftops and a tree line above the bridge. The artwork features a sketchy style with quick, expressive brushstrokes or pen lines. The color palette is primarily black ink on beige or off-white paper, emphasizing line and form. Flowing lines suggest water movement leading to the bridge, with buildings and a tree in the distance.
